basic_info.description: 81 Frank Norris is a secure, 7-story, 32-unit elevator building situated on a quiet side street. This top-floor, corner penthouse offers an open floor plan, expansive city views, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light. Upon entering you are immediately greeted by the sweeping views and are led into the open living space. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances including a dishwasher. Oversized windows on three sides of the bedroom offer sprawling city views to the north, east, and west, along with an abundance of natural light. Large en-suite bathroom. This home features an in-unit laundry closet with a Bosch washer and dryer, a deeded balcony, and access to a massive shared courtyard with seating and plants. Additional amenities include a large private storage unit and convenient bike storage.  Vibrant central location, this home sits in the heart of the Polk Street shopping corridor. Just blocks away from everything you need; dining options, grocery stores (1  blocks to Trader Joe's and Whole Foods), vintage shops, nightlife, picturesque Lafayette Park, public transport & all the conveniences of city living. Perfect for down-sizers, first time or pied-a-terre buyers. Parking secured on the block! Showings available by appt.
